field.label: Enable Custom Checkout Step
field.comment: Show the INSEAD financing / billing / tax step in checkout. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Programme Held in Singapore
field.comment: Controls the GST Declaration block: shown for non-Singapore, non-EU companies only when the programme is held in Singapore.

field.label: Show Gender Field (Self-funded)
field.comment: Show the Gender field on the Billing Information step for Self-funded (B2C). Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Gender Field (Sponsored by Organisation)
field.comment: Show the Gender field on the Billing Information step for Sponsored by Organisation (B2B). Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Nationality Field (Self-funded)
field.comment: Show the Nationality field on the Billing Information step for Self-funded (B2C). Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Show Nationality Field (Sponsored by Organisation)
field.comment: Show the Nationality field on the Billing Information step for Sponsored by Organisation (B2B). Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Phone Required (Self-funded)
field.comment: Whether the Phone field is mandatory on the Billing Information step for Self-funded (B2C). Set to No to make it optional. Configurable per website / store view.

field.label: Phone Required (Sponsored by Organisation)
field.comment: Whether the Phone field is mandatory on the Billing Information step for Sponsored by Organisation (B2B). Set to No to make it optional. Configurable per website / store view.

group.label: VAT / Tax Customer Group Mapping
group.comment: Which customer group to switch the quote to during tax calculation, based on billing country (EU/non-EU), VAT Intracommunity validity, and whether a supporting document (Certificate ID / Tax Exempt File) is present. See Observer\Vat\SetQuoteCustomerGroup.

group.label: Singapore GST Customer Group Mapping
group.comment: Which customer group to switch the quote to during tax calculation, based on the B2C/B2B financing profile, the Self-funded Singapore residency declaration, and the Sponsored by Organisation Tax Status. See Observer\Gst\SetQuoteCustomerGroup.

field.label: Enable Singapore GST Customer Group Mapping
field.comment: Set to Yes ONLY at the scope of the Singapore selling-entity store(s) (e.g. lhub_sgp). Mutually exclusive with the VAT / Tax Customer Group Mapping above — a store should use one mechanism or the other, never both. Not the same as "Programme Held in Singapore" above (that controls the GST Declaration form field, not this backend group swap, and is already Yes on stores that use the VAT mechanism).

field.label: B2C, Declares Will Be in Singapore During the Course
B2B, Tax Registered / Non Tax Registered (default)
B2B, Singapore Entity Declaration — GST Rate (%)
field.comment: Applied on top of the order subtotal when a B2B customer's `gst_declaration` answer indicates a Singapore GST nexus — independent of billing/shipping country (per spec, these customers stay in the B2B group either way). See Model\Total\Quote\Gst. Defaults to 9, matching the existing "Singapore 9%" tax rate.

field.label: B2B, Singapore Entity Declaration — Which Statements Count as GST Applicable
field.comment: Select which of the 4 GST Declaration statements (shown on the Billing Information step for B2B customers) should trigger the GST amount above. Defaults to statements 3 and 4 — this was a judgment call, not derived from the spec table (which only shows a Yes/No, not these 4 nuanced options); adjust if it doesn't match actual policy. See Model\Total\Quote\Gst.

field.label: Enable SIRET Auto-Fill
field.comment: Looks up the company legal name, trade name and postal address from the INSEE Sirene API once a valid 14-digit SIRET is entered on the France billing form.

field.label: INSEE API Key
field.comment: Value of the X-INSEE-Api-Key-Integration header, issued via your INSEE api.insee.fr application.

field.label: INSEE Sirene API Base URL
field.comment: E.g. https://api.insee.fr/api-sirene/3.11 — change only if INSEE ships a new API version.
